description: This file defines the ListToList class, which implements the list-to-list operation in the MiniLang environment of the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates the logic for transferring elements from one list to another within the method execution context, based on XML configuration.

classes.name: ListToList
classes.description: Implements a MiniLang operation to append the contents of one list to another, as specified by XML attributes.

classes.name: ListToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate ListToList objects from XML element definitions.

methods.name: ListToList
methods.description: Constructor initializing the operation with XML configuration and validating attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the list-to-list operation by copying elements from source to destination list within the method environment.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the list-to-list operation.

methods.description: Factory method to create a ListToList instance from an XML element.

methods.description: Returns the operation's XML tag name for identification.
